note: vespera-bridge: buffered request bodies whose wire frame cannot be encoded are answered 413 before they are read (servlet and WebFlux). Direct-buffer pool knobs parse like the other numeric properties (a leading zero is decimal). Negative top-level buffer caps and reactive-streaming counts, and a zero worker-thread or blocking-thread count, are rejected at binding. A blank Access-Control-Request-Method no longer fails the WebFlux preflight filter. CurrentUser falls through to the user-name lookup when the tmpdir probe is untrusted. Gradle plugin: an exact underscore package name wins over a hyphenated twin. Test fixes for the reactive preflight, the direct wrapper and the native-image metadata checks.
